reports.title: Blue River PFHA fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth Bass, Smallmouth Bass, Spotted Bass Good on crankbaits, flukes, spinnerbaits, topwater lures, tube jigs around brush structure, channels, river channel, rocks, shallows, shorelines, weed beds.

reports.title: Konawa fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth Bass Good on crankbaits, jerk baits, plastic baits around main lake, points, river channel, weed beds.

reports.title: Texoma fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie, White Crappie Fair on caddis flies, hair jigs, jigs, minnows, nymphs around brush structure, coves, docks, points, standing timber.
Crappie are good on minnows and jigs with power bait around docks with brush piles and in open water on ledges with brush.

reports.title: Keystone Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie, White Crappie Good on jigs, minnows around brush structure, docks, main lake.
Largemouth Bass Fair on jigs, minnows, plastic baits around brush structure.

reports.title: McGee Creek fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass, Spotted Bass Good on bill baits, crankbaits, plastic baits around brush structure, rocks, shallows, shorelines.
Black Crappie, White Crappie Slow on minnows, small lures, tube jigs around brush structure, standing timber.

reports.title: Broken Bow Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass, Smallmouth Bass, Spotted Bass Good on Alabama rig, crankbaits, crawfish, plastic baits, spinnerbaits, worms around coves, points.
Black Crappie, White Crappie Good on jigs around brush structure, creek channels, standing timber.

reports.title: Hugo Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass, Spotted Bass Slow on jigs, plastic baits around brush structure, river channel, standing timber.
Black Crappie, White Crappie Slow on jigs, minnows, small lures around brush structure, channels, standing timber.

reports.title: Pine Creek Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass Slow on crankbaits, plastic baits around coves, points.
White Crappie Slow on jigs, minnows.

reports.title: Sardis Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass Good on bill baits, crankbaits, lipless baits, plastic baits, spinnerbaits around brush structure, points, standing timber.
Black Crappie, White Crappie Good on jigs, minnows around brush structure, standing timber.
